title: Base and Break
briefing: Kestrel Air has been stuck between about $36 and $40 for a month. Breakouts are coming, but not every move above $40 will be real.
objective: Breakout trading: wait for a close above the base on strong volume, and keep the stop inside the base.
debrief: Kestrel Air built a tight base. On day 10, travel chatter nudged it above $40 on light volume, and it slid back inside the base when the chatter faded on day 13: a false breakout. On day 20, record bookings and twelve new routes sent it through $40 on heavy volume, and it kept going. A disciplined player skipped the quiet poke, bought the confirmed break and kept a stop back inside the base.
